description: Fetch live billing data from the BillingServ API: customers, invoices (including unpaid and overdue), payment methods, transactions, orders, subscriptions, packages, discounts, usage meters, tax and staff settings, and sales/revenue reports. Use this for any question about billing, invoices, customers, orders, or revenue. Only allowlisted endpoints can be called.

endpoint.description: Allowlisted BillingServ API endpoint path, relative to /api/v2.

path.description: Path parameter values for endpoints with placeholders, such as customer_id and order_id.

query.description: Query string parameters to pass to the BillingServ API endpoint.

name: billingserv_get
title: Query live BillingServ billing data
